summary: Concentra Group Holdings filed an 8-K reporting Q2 2026 results and a CEO transition. CEO Keith Newton will resign effective November 1, 2026, becoming Executive Chairman; Chair Robert Ortenzio will step down as Chair but remain director. President and CFO Matthew DiCanio was appointed CEO and Class III director, effective same date. No compensation terms disclosed yet; CFO succession to be announced before transition. Board approved adding one seat. This is a non-routine executive succession event, distinct from ordinary meeting notices; the departure is voluntary but constitutes a management change.
